title: The Home page, round 4 — pills as tabs, and the Climate page swapped

steps.path: Pages → Home, the pills at the top
steps.headline: The pills are now the page's tabs: Home comes first, and the open one is filled in solid.
steps.changed: Your notes: the back button is gone; Home is a pill; each pill is a page and shows clearly when it is the one open. Pressing the open pill keeps you there; Home returns to every room.
steps.notice: The Climate pill shows the real sky instead of a thermometer: a moon tonight, a sun, clouds, rain or snow by day. It comes from your Home Assistant's weather, which is set to your home's location.
steps.risk: Page settings (the gear) is still a separate button on the right, not a pill.

steps.headline: On the Climate page the weather is now on the left and the thermostat on the right, larger.
steps.changed: Your note: swap their positions. The header no longer has a back button; it shows the page's icon and title.
steps.notice: On a narrow window they stack, weather on top.
